lines.text: Ты видел, что сейчас произошло в зале?
lines.trans: Did you see what just happened in the hall?

lines.text: Наш бармен смело подошёл к столику критика.
lines.trans: Our bartender boldly stepped up to the critic's table.

lines.text: Этот критик опять грубо обижал нашу Настю.
lines.trans: This critic was rudely insulting our Nastya again.

words.gloss: to hurt, to offend, to bully

lines.text: Костя не стал терпеть такое наглое поведение.
lines.trans: Kostya did not start tolerating such insolent behavior.

words.gloss: to bear, to put up with; to hold on

lines.text: Что, гость заказал напиток из бара сейчас?
lines.trans: What, did the guest order a drink from the bar now?

lines.text: Точно, он получил заказ по полной программе!
lines.trans: Exactly, he received an order to the fullest program!

lines.text: Костя вылил стакан прямо на его костюм!
lines.trans: Kostya poured a glass right onto his suit!

lines.text: Наш тихий бармен оказался настоящим храбрым героем.
lines.trans: Our quiet bartender turned out to be a real brave hero.

words.gloss: to turn out to be, find oneself

lines.text: Теперь этот важный критик весь мокрый сидит.
lines.trans: Now this important critic sits completely wet.

lines.text: Но шеф будет ужасно зол из-за скандала.
lines.trans: But the chef will be terribly angry because of the scandal.

lines.text: Виктория уже быстро бежит в обеденный зал.
lines.trans: Victoria is already quickly running into the dining hall.

lines.text: Косте сейчас точно грозит очень быстрое увольнение.
lines.trans: A very swift dismissal definitely threatens Kostya right now.

lines.text: Зато он храбро защитил свою любимую девушку!
lines.trans: At least he courageously protected his beloved girl!

words.gloss: but on the other hand, to make up for it

meanings.note: person serving drinks at the bar

examples.text: Бармен наливает холодную воду в стакан.
examples.trans: The bartender pours cold water into the glass.

meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: бегу, бежишь, ..., бегут

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!
Where are you running so fast?

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
moving or capable of moving at high speed
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
I can see the toy car.

meanings.en: to pour out, empty, dump (liquid) onto

examples.text: Он мне вылил кашу на голову!
examples.trans: He poured porridge on my head!
Pour the cold water out of the cup.

meanings.note: a brave person; also the main character of a story
at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.
A prison sentence threatens for this.
He shook his fist at us.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

зато.gloss: but on the other hand, to make up for it

meanings.en: but on the other hand, at least

examples.text: Четыре по алгебре, зато по физкультуре пятёрка.
examples.trans: A four in algebra, but a five in gym.
The flat is small, but at least it's in the centre.
He will be able to protect me.

meanings.note: злая собака = vicious dog; а почему вы такая злая? = why are you so hostile?
+ genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!
We were late because of the rain.
There's someone here to see you.
This is my wedding suit, actually!
The restaurant critic praised the bartender.

examples.text: А ты готовишь мой любимый торт со сгущёнкой!
examples.trans: And you make my favourite condensed milk cake!

examples.text: Теперь этот критик весь мокрый сидит в зале.
examples.trans: Now this critic sits completely wet in the dining room.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: showing a lack of respect in a rude or aggressive manner

examples.trans: That was a very insolent act.
The bartender made a delicious cold beverage.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.
The dining hall of the restaurant.

обижать.gloss: to hurt, to offend, to bully

meanings.en: to hurt, to mistreat, to offend

оказаться.gloss: to turn out to be, find oneself

meanings.en: to turn out to be, prove to be

examples.trans: You turned out to be ungrateful.

examples.text: Он внезапно оказался в центре событий.
examples.trans: He suddenly found himself in the center of events.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.
She was fired for her conduct.

meanings.en: to come up to, to approach

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.

meanings.note: an election programme, a TV programme

examples.trans: The programme will be on the website.

meanings.note: usually 3rd person: что произошло? = what happened?

examples.text: Я не знаю, как это произошло.
examples.trans: I don't know how it happened.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: Why are you sitting in the corner?
A scandal began in the restaurant dining room.
There is no need to make a scene.

examples.text: Они заняли свободный столик у окна.
examples.trans: They took a free table near the window.

терпеть.gloss: to bear, to put up with; to hold on

meanings.en: to put up with, to bear

meanings.note: e.g. to wait for the toilet

examples.trans: Stick it in a quiet spot.

examples.text: Я точно не помню его адрес.
examples.trans: I don't remember his exact address.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.text: Он написал заявление об увольнении с работы.
examples.trans: He wrote a letter of resignation from work.
It is terribly cold outside today.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

examples.text: Бармен очень храбро защитил свою девушку.
examples.trans: The bartender very bravely protected his girlfriend.
The brave soldier defended the city.
I'm sick of this communal flat.
